providers.title: API keys
providers.hint: Write-only: saved keys are never shown.

providers.loginDevice: Sign in to {{provider}}: open the page and enter the code

local.title: Local servers
local.hint: vLLM, Ollama, LM Studio and OmniRoute are addressed by URL.

mcp.title: MCP — Model Context Protocol
mcp.hint: External tool servers; the engine reloads them when you save.
mcp.sdkMissing: The <pkg>mcp</pkg> package is not installed in the engine environment. Install it with <cmd>pip install "phoson-engine-minimal[mcp]"</cmd>.
mcp.transportHint: stdio for local processes; sse/http for remote servers
mcp.commandHint: They run as-is, exactly like in the terminal
mcp.envHint: One per line: KEY=value. They are stored in mcps.json and never shown back.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.hint: The ones the engine ships and the ones you install. Changes are saved to config.toml and the engine reloads.
plugins.empty: No plugins to show: the engine did not expose its catalog and config.toml lists none.
plugins.missingExtra: Enabled, but the [{{extra}}] extra is missing from the engine environment: the engine skips it.

lock.dictation: Controlled from the Dictation section, not this list.
lock.peerName: Turned on by the peer_name option in config.toml.
lock.file: Enabled by “{{field}}” in config.toml; the engine reads it but saving does not write it.
lock.env: Enabled by the {{variable}} environment variable; it cannot be changed here.

install.sourceHint: PyPI package, git repository (or its URL), or local path.
install.confirmTitle: You are about to install third-party code:
install.warning: A plugin is Python code that runs with your permissions. Install it only if you trust the source.
install.slow: This may take a while: it resolves the commit, installs the package and looks for its entry point.
install.frozen: This app bundles the engine, so it cannot install plugins. Use “phoson-cli plugin install” from an installation with Python and uv.
install.noUv: uv is required on the PATH to install plugins: phoson-cli installs them with “uv pip install”.
install.unavailable: Plugin installation is not available on this machine.

agent.title: Agent and sessions
agent.safeModeHint: Asks for confirmation before running commands (bash).

dictation.title: Dictation
dictation.hint: Language and model for voice dictation (Moonshine, on-device).
dictation.languageHint: "Automatic" follows the interface language; a specific one fixes it for every capture.
dictation.modelHint: Bigger models are more accurate but slower; the default is small-streaming.
dictation.downloadHint: Pre-downloads the model so the first capture doesn't have to wait.

desktop.title: Desktop
desktop.hint: System notices and the system tray (Windows).
desktop.notifyHint: How to alert you when a turn finishes (or asks for confirmation) in the background.
desktop.closeToTrayHint: Closing the window keeps the app alive in the system tray. Quit it from its own menu.
desktop.sendToTrayHint: Hides the window; the agent and its turns keep running.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.hint: Local app preference (not stored in config.toml).
appearance.languageHint: Interface language; remembered on this machine.

about.title: About
about.hint: Signed updates served from the release feed.
about.logsHint: Local diagnostics: every action, RPC and error (rotating JSONL). Nothing leaves your machine.
about.upToDate: You are on the latest version.
